images.title: 2-4-_MG_0259
images.alt: Close profile of a woman with her eyes closed against a rusted metal shutter, punk safety pins in her dark hair above Westwood-style pearls and an embroidered drape, from a Fashion Communication student concept shoot imagining House of Anita Dongre meeting Vivienne Westwood.

images.title: 3-2-_MG_0276
images.alt: A woman seated on bare earth against a stacked red-brick wall, turning to look at the camera, a soft embroidered sari drape met by a sculpted black corset: the Dongre romanticism and Westwood defiance this student concept shoot was built to contrast.

images.title: Hirayat1
images.alt: Two people in loose white clothing dancing barefoot beside a forest stream, one twirling the other under tall trees in low light, a fleeting moment of joy inside Hiraeth’s yearning for a home you can’t return to.
images.exif: Camera: Canon EOS 6D, Lens: Canon EF 100mm f/2.8L Macro IS USM, Focal length: 100 mm, Aperture: f/5.6, Shutter: 1/30 s, ISO: 200

images.title: Hirayat2
images.alt: A person dressed in white at the edge of a forest stream, one arm outstretched toward a hand reaching in from off-frame: the unspoken pull of a place you can’t quite return to, at the heart of this Hiraeth shoot.
images.exif: Camera: Canon EOS 6D, Lens: Canon EF 100mm f/2.8L Macro IS USM, Focal length: 100 mm, Aperture: f/5.6, Shutter: 1/30 s, ISO: 200

images.title: Hirayat3
images.alt: Close-up of a bare foot mid-step on dark forest ground scattered with small white flowers, the hem of a white garment above, a quiet tactile fragment of Hiraeth’s intimate journey through lost worlds.
images.exif: Camera: Canon EOS 6D, Lens: Canon EF 100mm f/2.8L Macro IS USM, Focal length: 100 mm, Aperture: f/5.6, Shutter: 1/30 s, ISO: 200

images.title: Hirayat4
images.alt: A person with long curly copper hair sitting beside a dark rock in dense green foliage, arms folded, gazing upward, the kind of glance the Hiraeth concept describes as telling the story of a search for home.
images.exif: Camera: Canon EOS 6D, Lens: Canon EF 100mm f/2.8L Macro IS USM, Focal length: 100 mm, Aperture: f/5.6, Shutter: 1/30 s, ISO: 200

images.title: Hirayat5
images.alt: Two people seen from behind embracing under bamboo and trees, one resting a hand on the back of the other’s dark hair, an intimate gesture in a series about a time that has slipped through your fingers.
images.exif: Camera: Canon EOS 6D, Lens: Canon EF 100mm f/2.8L Macro IS USM, Focal length: 100 mm, Aperture: f/5.6, Shutter: 1/30 s, ISO: 200
